name: my-website
originalPrompt:
Create a luxury photography portfolio website
for a professional photographer.

Use a minimalist black and white design.
Make photography the main focus.

Include:
- Full-screen hero photograph
- Photographer introduction
- Large visual photo gallery
- Wedding photography collection
- Portrait photography collection
- Travel photography collection
- About the photographer
- Client testimonials
- Booking and contact form

Use elegant serif typography, spacious layouts,
beautiful image grids and subtle hover animations.
